text:
anya: Quick note — our quickstart README cURL example is breaking for PowerShell users. It uses single quotes so $REDWOOD_API_KEY doesn't expand; also found inconsistent env var names across samples (JS uses REDWOOD_API_KEY, Go has REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY). Docs also say "SDK retries enabled" but Node SDK has retries off by default. Getting support tickets.

matt: Repro'd on Windows (PowerShell). Minimal repro that fails in pwsh:

```bash
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

PowerShell treats single quotes as literal so env vars don't expand.

lia: Proposed docs fix: show POSIX and PowerShell variants and a short note about shells. POSIX (bash/zsh):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

PowerShell (pwsh):

```powershell
$body = @{ input = 'hi' } | ConvertTo-Json
Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post -Uri 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate' -Headers @{ Authorization = "Bearer $env:REDWOOD_API_KEY" } -Body $body -ContentType 'application/json'
```

sam: Also, let's standardize the env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY across all language snippets and add a changelog note about REDWOOD_LEGACY_KEY deprecation.

anya: And clarify SDK retry defaults in the quickstart troubleshooting section: Node: retries = off (show how to enable), Python: retries = 3, Go: retries = 2. Link to the SDK retry policies doc.

devex-bot: Created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/2501 ; draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/201 (assigned to @matt)

matt: I'll update the README with both cURL examples, change the Go snippet to use REDWOOD_API_KEY, add the changelog entry and include a small retry defaults table. Will ping support after merge. :thumbsup:

lia: I'll add the PowerShell snippet to the onboarding email templates so new users see it up front.
